script.base: KC -7.5, total 41.5, implied KC 24.5 / LAC 17.0 is a controlled KC lead, not a shootout. Walker (64 carries, 364 yards in the weeks 2-4 window) gets the late clock work; Mahomes stays efficient rather than volume-max. LAC, without T Joe Alt and G Kayode Awosika and already -0.34 EPA/dropback vs blitz against KC's 29% blitz, struggles to stay on schedule, so the Hampton/Mitchell/Vidal committee fades if they trail.
script.flip1: LAC hangs around or leads: Herbert's rush role has climbed (window games 17, 40, 54) and KC is without T Josh Simmons, so Chargers steal the script. KC then throws to the Rice-less group (Worthy, Thornton, Kelce) into a LAC secondary missing Derwin James and Donte Jackson, and Walker's carries slide toward the 70-yard week.
script.flip2: KC is up big by halftime. Walker still cashes early rush volume, then late snaps get managed; LAC pass volume dies if the game is out of reach, and Emmett Johnson (8 carries, 32 yards in the KC window) can vulture garbage carries.

injury_fallout: KC WR Rashee Rice Out (hamstring; 15 targets, 171 yards in the weeks 2-4 window) pushes looks to Kelce (17/175), Worthy (16/115), Thornton (14/219, not in the priced board), Walker (13/66), Gray and Royals. KC T Josh Simmons Out (back) is the run-game risk for Walker. KC CB L'Jarius Sneed is only Questionable, so do not assume a secondary downgrade. LAC WR Tre Harris Out (16 targets, 152 yards, 182 air in weeks 3-5) leaves McConkey, Johnston, Gadsden, Mitchell and Vidal to split a modest ~5 targets/game, not a guaranteed yardage bump. LAC T Joe Alt Out and G Kayode Awosika Out raise pressure on Herbert (already worse vs blitz). LAC S Derwin James Out, CB Donte Jackson Out and CB Rodney Shelley Doubtful help KC explosives, but Worthy 49 and Kelce 52 have no two-sided price. LAC DT Dalvin Tomlinson, DT Jamaree Caldwell, DE Bud Dupree and LB Daiyan Henley are Questionable, which softens the front Walker runs into if any sit. Final inactives (~90 min pre-kick) are not in the pack. Sources: pack injury report, KC weeks 2-4 targets, LAC weeks 3-5 targets.

matchup.shell: Not charted. Pack has no MOFO/MOFC or man/zone rate. Proxy only: KC blitz 29%, LAC blitz 27%.
matchup.pressure: KC blitz 29% and LAC EPA/dropback is -0.34 vs blitz vs -0.17 vs none, so pressure should cut LAC deep yards and funnel short throws. LAC blitz 27% and KC EPA/dropback is +0.42 vs blitz vs +0.13 vs none, so Mahomes does not have to check down.
matchup.bleeds: KC pass D YPA: middle 8.44 (39), left 6.23 (52), right 4.96 (53); rush YPC allowed 3.61, 11 runs of 10+. LAC pass D YPA: left 8.25 (56), right 7.25 (53), middle 5.59 (32); rush YPC allowed 4.04, 13 runs of 10+, 14 passes of 20+.
matchup.overlap: Bettable overlap is Walker's feature-back role into LAC's 4.04 YPC and a questionable front, not a WR-vs-zone overlap. KC's middle bleed (8.44) would fit Kelce/slot, but those boards are unpriced on two sides, so that overlap is not a leg.

pro_edge.implied_totals: KC 24.5, LAC 17.0 from (41.5+7.5)/2 and (41.5-7.5)/2. Low total: not a volume shootout. Underdog by 7.5+ should throw more; leader should run late. Blowout snap risk is moderate, not a 14-point flag.
pro_edge.script_read: Favorite-runs-the-clock. Walker carry share is the script leg. LAC skill overs need the trail flip and are a different story. Price check does not add a second side: consensus no-vig on the Walker rush over is 0.505.
pro_edge.best_price: kennethwalkeriii rushyds over 91.5 best -116.5, same as the saved consensus main line; anchor no-vig over 0.505 / under 0.495. No book in the inputs beats that anchor. Herbert rush over -111 is also just the consensus (no-vig over 0.494).
pro_edge.lagging: No lagging-line flag in the precomputed scan. No book off consensus and no saved prop move after the spread/total. Worthy 49, Kelce 52, Johnston 36, Gadsden 15 and Hampton rush 34 have no two-sided price, so they cannot be shopped.
pro_edge.sleepers: Rice Out and Harris Out are the sleeper triggers. Royals 24.5 vs last4 6, 11, 0 is not a cheap unmoved over. Gray 14.5 is near his window (56 yards / 3). McConkey 42.5 is not clearly stale (most recent log 0; window role only 7 targets). No Doubtful/Out teammate has a saved line that is obviously unmoved and bettable. Sneed, Dupree, Tomlinson, Henley, Caldwell, Lambert-Smith and Thompson are Questionable only.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Walker should clear 91.5 because KC's lead-and-clock script gives him the 21-carry role that produced 117, 70 and 177 in the window (364 yards, 5.69 YPC) against a LAC run defense allowing 4.04 YPC with Tomlinson, Caldwell, Dupree and Henley all questionable, and Rice being out does not steal carries.
edge_players.must_be_true: Walker is active for a full workload, carries stay around 20-23 so the over still cashes if YPC regresses toward 4.5, and KC is not chasing for most of the game. Simmons being out cannot collapse the run.
edge_players.kills_it: Flip 1: LAC leads, KC passes into the James/Jackson-less secondary, and carries fall toward the 70-yard week. Also a Simmons-driven efficiency drop (21 carries at 4.0 YPC is only 84) or a true blowout that sits him before 90 yards.

data_check.notes: No projection, no sims, no named Pinnacle in the pack, so step 8 cannot be completed and the 3-point gate is not officially passed. Consensus no-vig over is 0.505. Raw form is 3 of 4 over 91.5 (0.75); that is suspicion-capped to a 0.58 prior, not a sim median. The 70-yard window game and Simmons Out disagree with a pure efficiency story and are why this is flagged, not cut. Carry math is tight if YPC falls to LAC's 4.04 (needs ~23 carries). McConkey, Royals, Johnson and Herbert were checked and not added: McConkey log does not match the window, Royals form is 6/11/0 against a 24.5 sleeper over, Johnson under 24.5 is a coin-flip backup number with 35 and 68 rush+rec games against a 4.04 YPC front, Herbert rush over fights the underdog-throws script and KC's 3.61 YPC allowed.

market_rung_price: kennethwalkeriii rushyds over 91.5 at -116.5, saved consensus main line. No alt rung in the pack. Anchor consensus no-vig over 0.505 / under 0.495. Do not take a shorter alt. One market only; rush+rec 117.5 is the worse rung because receiving was 61 then 3 then 2.
pre_mortem: It's Monday and Walker under 91.5 lost the ticket because Simmons' absence let LAC's front, if Tomlinson and Caldwell played, stone the run the way the 70-yard week did, and because James and Jackson being out plus Rice being out turned KC into a pass-first favorite. Twenty-one carries at a regressed 4.0 YPC is 84, not 92. A halftime blowout could also have parked him after a quiet first half. That counter-case is real, which is why the human gets a flag, but it is not stronger than the base lead-and-clock read plus a line 25 yards under his window median.
slip_story: One story only: KC leads and runs the clock. Walker rush over is the anchor. Do not pair it with LAC skill overs, a total over, or Walker's own receiving/rush+rec. Johnson rush+rec under 24.5 is the same story but was dropped because the counter-case matches the read. No TD legs, no second market.
